'''Vray''' was a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as part of the [[Mantellian Army|Mantellian army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during part of the war, where he fought the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] in the [[Separatist War|Ord Mantell Civil War]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Biography==
Vray was a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Mantellian Army|Mantellian army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a conflict between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the Republic. During the war he held the rank of [[Commander/Legends|commander]] and was deployed on the Republic-held [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]]<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EGPM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> While stationed on the planet he and all Republic forces aided the corrupt local government in fighting the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]].<ref name="TOR" />

While stationed on Ord Mantell Vray worked out of [[Fort Garnik]], a Republic stronghold on the planet. During the war the Separatist forces captured [[Drelliad village]], a small village near Garnik. Republic soldiers were sent to retake the settlement and protect refugees fleeing from the Separatist forces there. The Separatists, however, stationed [[Sniper/Legends|snipers]] along the main route from Garnik to Drelliad who fired on any non-separatist traveling along it, civilian and soldier alike. In an effort to retake the route Vray offered a week's salary to anyone who could defeat a number of the snipers.<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Vray's offer was taken up by a Republic individual who was informed of the pay available by [[Private/Legends|Private]] [[Wesner]], a soldier attacking Drelliad. The individual then killed at least three of the snipers on the route and other Separatists guarding them. When they reached Garnik, Vray thanked them for clearing the route and paid them the promised amount, which came to 50 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] as well as a pair of minor [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]] and a [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulant]].<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Equipment==
Whilst at Fort Garnik Vray wore [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]] with four ammo pockets on the chest and a pair of beige pants with knee [[Boot/Legends|boots]]. He was armed with a pistol which he kept attached to his belt at the hip.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vray is a non-player character from the [[Star Wars video games#Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].
